title.narrative: CAFOD support to Caritas Chile earthquake appeal - EA 01/2010 CHILE

description.narrative:
This grant of £50,000 is a contribution to the Caritas Appeal (EA 04 /2010) in response to the earthquake and resultant tsunami in Chile on 27th February 2010. The Flash Appeal is for a 9 months emergency response phase and initial recovery phase to meet the immediate and medium term needs of the most affected populations in Regions 6, 7, 8, 9 which have been the most badly affected. There are six objectives in total:
1. Target populations have food, water, clothing and hygiene kits. NOTE: Funding for food baskets will come from national sources. No funding from international organisations is intended for food provision.
2. Target populations have adequate and dignified temporary shelter and longer term housing 3. Livelihoods of the most vulnerable are revived (especially, peasant, fishermen, and urban vulnerable)
Caritas Chile will also strive to give appropriate spiritual and psychosocial support to the victims. They are also mindful of ensuring the most efficient use of resources available and to that end will engage on a regular basis with other organisations involved in the relief effort.
In relation to the overall EA which is for US$13,110,534 / €9,364,667, CAFOD's contribution is relatively small and will not therefore be earmarked for a specific component of the project but will rather contribute to the overall response.
